{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test: LRU eviction doesn't leave stale memberships
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
# Now cache is full: a, b
c.put('c', 3, ['z'])  # evicts 'a' (LRU)
# 'a' should be gone, tag 'x' membership should be gone
result = c.invalidate('x')
print(f'invalidating old tag after eviction: {result}')  # should be 0

# Test: replacing a key removes old tag memberships
c2 = TaggedCache(2)
c2.put('a', 1, ['old'])
c2.put('a', 2, ['new'])
result = c2.invalidate('old')
print(f'invalidating old tag after replacement: {result}')  # should be 0
result2 = c2.invalidate('new')
print(f'invalidating new tag after replacement: {result2}')  # should be 1

# Test: get refreshes LRU recency
c3 = TaggedCache(2)
c3.put('a', 1)
c3.put('b', 2)
c3.get('a')  # make 'a' most recent
c3.put('c', 3)  # should evict 'b' (least recent)
print(f'after get refresh: {\"b\" not in c3 and \"a\" in c3}')  # should be True

# Test: mode='all' requires every tag
c4 = TaggedCache(5)
c4.put('a', 1, ['x', 'y'])
c4.put('b', 2, ['x', 'z'])
c4.put('c', 3, ['y', 'z'])
result = c4.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='all')
print(f'mode=all with [x,y]: {result}')  # should be 1 (only 'a')

# Test: mode='any' requires any tag (union)
result2 = c4.invalidate_many(['x', 'y'], mode='any')
print(f'mode=any with [x,y]: {result2}')  # should be 3 (a,b,c all match)
